```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lme4)
library(patchwork)
library(afex)
library(doParallel)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
Neuroethics_Judgement <- read.csv(here("data", "Cleaned_Pilot", "clean_data_long.csv"), stringsAsFactors=TRUE)
data <- Neuroethics_Judgement %>% dplyr::select(user_id, condition, gain, risk, experimental_treatment_selected, conservatismFactor) %>% 
  mutate(experimental_treatment_selected = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0))

#data <- data %>% filter(risk <= 45 & gain <= 45)
  
  
continuous <- c("risk", "gain")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(risk, gain)) + geom_point() + theme_minimal()

p1 <- data %>% ggplot(aes(risk, fill = condition)) + geom_histogram(bins = 9, color  = "black",  fill="#ee7c2e") + theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~ experimental_treatment_selected)
  
p2 <- data %>% ggplot(aes(gain)) + geom_histogram(bins = 9, color  = "black", fill="#4673c3") + theme_minimal()+  facet_wrap(~experimental_treatment_selected)
```

```{r}
library(ggridges)

p6 <- data %>%
  filter(experimental_treatment_selected == 1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(risk, y =condition, fill = condition)) + geom_density_ridges() + 
  theme_ridges()+theme(legend.position = "none")

p7 <- data %>%
  filter(experimental_treatment_selected == 1) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(gain, y =condition, fill = condition)) + geom_density_ridges() + 
  theme_ridges()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

(p6 / p7)
# try a ggstatsplot::ggwithinstats() for all the cogntive domains to shown consistnently acorss

```


```{r}
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')

#data[,continuous] <- scale(data[,continuous]) #scale the data

data <- data %>% #within subject scaling imporantntn when coviarite vlaues are differnenet, very differeney
  group_by(user_id) %>%
  mutate(risk = scale(risk),
         gain = scale(gain)) %>% 
  ungroup()

m.1 <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ 1 + (risk + gain)*conservatismFactor + (1 + risk + gain| user_id), 
             data = data, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 1)
summary(m.1)
# cl <- makeCluster(4)
# clusterEvalQ(cl, require(lme4))
# confi <- confint(m.1,method="boot", nsim = 1000)
# stopCluster(cl)
#save(confi, file = here("output", "Confidence_Intervals_for_Model_Parameters.RData"))

# cl <- makeCluster(4)
# clusterEvalQ(cl, require(afex))
# lrMod1.lr <- mixed(experimental_treatment_selected ~ 1 + risk + gain + I(risk^2) + I(gain^2)+
#                    (1 + risk + gain | user_id),
#                    data=data,
#                    family="binomial", method='LRT',
#                    control=glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"), 
#                    nAGQ = 1)
# stopCluster(cl)
# 
# lrMod1.lr

#print(VarCorr(m.1),comp=c("Variance","Std.Dev."), digits=3)

se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m.1)))
# table of estimates with 95% CI
(tab <- cbind(Est = fixef(m.1), LL = fixef(m.1) - 1.96 * se, UL = fixef(m.1) + 1.96 * se)) %>% 
  kable(caption = "95% Confidence Intervals for Fixed effect Parameters")%>%  
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")

#exp(tab) #we take the exponetial to get the odds rather than log odds
broom.mixed::tidy(m.1)%>% 
  kable(caption = "Summary of Fixed and Random Effects for Model")%>%  
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
#getME(m.1, "theta")

as.matrix(Matrix::bdiag(VarCorr(m.1))) %>%
  kable(caption = "G Matrix for Random Effects")%>%  
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")#Here is the G matrix
```

```{r subject models and graphs, fig.width= 11}
set.seed(2022)
p3 <- ggeffects::ggpredict(m.1, terms = c("risk", "gain [-1, 0, 1]","user_id [sample=25]"), type = "re") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x, predicted, color = facet, fill = factor(group)))+ 
  geom_line()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_grid(~ factor(group))+
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability across risk and gain",
       x = "Risk",
       y = "Predicted Probability of Selecting Treatment",
       color = "Subject ID") + geom_hline(yintercept = .50, linetype = "dashed")+
   theme(legend.position="none")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(group = factor(group)), se = F, color = "black")

p4 <- ggeffects::ggpredict(m.1, terms = c("risk", "gain [-1, 0 , 1]","user_id [sample=25]"), type = "re") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x, predicted, color = factor(group)))+ 
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~facet)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability by random sample of subjects",
       x = "Risk",
       y = "Predicted Probability",
       color = "Gain")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50, linetype = "dashed")

(p1 | p2) / p3 | p4
```

```{r cats, fig.width= 11}
cat_data <- Neuroethics_Judgement %>% dplyr::select(user_id, condition, gain, risk, experimental_treatment_selected) %>% 
  mutate(experimental_treatment_selected = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(risk = factor(risk),
         gain = factor(gain))

#cat_data <- cat_data %>% filter(risk <= 45 & gain <= 45)

cat.m <- glmer(experimental_treatment_selected ~ 1 + risk + gain +
             (1 | user_id), 
             data = cat_data, family = binomial(link="logit"), 
             control=glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa"),
             nAGQ = 1)

cats <- ggeffects::ggpredict(cat.m, terms = c("risk[all]", "gain[all]"))
  ggplot(cats, 
       aes(x = group, 
           y = predicted,
           fill = x)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",position = "dodge", color = "black")+
    labs(title = "Predicted Probability",
       x = "Gain",
       y = "Predicted Probability",
       fill = "Risk")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50, linetype = "dashed")+
    theme_bw()+
    facet_wrap(~x)

broom.mixed::tidy(cat.m)%>% 
  kable(caption = "Summary of Fixed and Random Effects for Categorical Model")%>%  
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

read.csv(here("data", "Cleaned_Pilot", "Post_hoc_risk_test_all_batches.csv"), header=TRUE, comment.char="#", stringsAsFactors=TRUE) %>%

```{r}
ggeffects::ggpredict(m.1, terms = c("risk [all]","user_id [sample=200]"), type = "re") %>% 
    left_join(distinct(select(data, user_id, conservatismFactor)), by = c("group" = "user_id")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x, predicted, color = factor(group)))+ 
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~conservatismFactor)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability by Conservatism",
       x = "Risk",
       y = "Predicted Probability",
       color = "Subject")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = .50, linetype = "dashed")+
     theme(legend.position="none")



subject_models <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, ranef(m.1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  mutate(user_id = factor(str_remove(rowname, "user_id."))) %>%
  mutate(Intercept = `(Intercept)` + fixef(m.1)[["(Intercept)"]],
         risk = risk + fixef(m.1)[["risk"]],
         gain = gain + fixef(m.1)[["gain"]]) %>%
    select(-c(rowname, `(Intercept)`)) %>% 
  left_join(select(data, user_id, condition, conservatismFactor), by = "user_id") %>% distinct()

do.call(rbind.data.frame, ranef(m.1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  mutate(user_id = factor(str_remove(rowname, "user_id."))) %>%
  left_join(select(data, user_id, condition, conservatismFactor), by = "user_id") %>% distinct() %>% 
ggplot(aes(risk, fill = factor(conservatismFactor))) + geom_histogram(bins = 20, color  = "black") + theme_minimal() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+ facet_wrap(~conservatismFactor)

tes <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, ranef(m.1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column() %>%
  mutate(user_id = factor(str_remove(rowname, "user_id."))) %>%
  left_join(select(data, user_id, condition, conservatismFactor), by = "user_id") %>% distinct()
```
